system.description:
Range 60ft; one creature (V, S).

  • At will, as your action.
  • The target makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC, taking force damage on a failure or half on a success. No slot required.
  • The damage is 1d8, 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th and 4d8 at 17th, with no ability bonus.
  • Eldritch Blast is a class feature, not a spell on the Warlock list; spend Patron Favour on it as the Warlock's Eldritch Blast feature says (HB v0.10.89).

Classes: Warlock (class-only spell, from the class entry)
system.damage: (1 + min(1, floor(@cl / 5)) + min(1, floor(@cl / 11)) + min(1, floor(@cl / 17)))d8
